gra_dad.text: Graham. Our motto's 'Ne oublie': do not forget. The Grahams of the Esk were Border reivers, and in 1606 the Crown shipped hundreds of them off to Ireland to tidy the frontier. Some say the family tree has never recovered.
Fun fact: round here 'lal' means little, a 'yat' is a gate, and 'bairn' means child, same as over the Border. We're not so far apart as the line on the map suggests.
